name: @mercatus-liber/adapter-shipstation
description: ShippingAdapter (@mercatus-liber/shipping) backed by ShipStation API v2 (api.shipstation.com/v2, API-Key header): POST /v2/rates for rates, POST /v2/labels/rates/{rate_id} to buy a label, PUT /v2/labels/{label_id}/void to void one, and GET /v2/labels/{label_id}/track for tracking by label id. Built from ShipStation's published OpenAPI spec, tested against fakes, never called against a live account. Uses global fetch; no HTTP dependency.
